assessment_objectives.objective: scenarios in which a third-party relationship may be terminated unexpectedly or the third-party may be unable or unwilling to support an orderly transition (e.g., insolvency, breach, sanctions, service withdrawal) are identified for applicable third-party relationships.

documented contingency measures exist to maintain security, compliance and resilience of affected Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) when a third-party relationship is terminated unexpectedly.

documented contingency measures exist to maintain continuity of operations, including alternate sourcing, internally-managed fallback and/or escrow arrangements, when the third-party is unable or unwilling to support an orderly transition.
contingency measures for third-party exit are tested or exercised at a defined frequency for critical third-party relationships.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually for critical third-party relationships

assessment_objectives.objective: the conditions and authority for invoking third-party exit contingency measures are defined and, when invoked, the invocation is recorded.
